headline_cluster.headline: מהמזיקים ביותר בעולם: מין פולש של נמלה התגלה בישראל
זוהתה בשכונה בחיפה: הנמלה המזיקה פלשה לישראל

claims.claim_he_or_en: מהמזיקים ביותר בעולם: מין פולש של נמלה התגלה בישראל
claims.verified_figure: Pheidole megacephala (big-headed ant) appears on the IUCN SSC ISSG list '100 of the World's Worst Invasive Alien Species' (Global Invasive Species Database), entry #68 of 100.
claims.note: The headline's vague framing ('among the world's most harmful') matches the species' listing on the IUCN/ISSG 100 Worst list. Only the headline was available (body not fetched, HTTP 403), so only the headline was audited.

claims.claim_he_or_en: מדורגת בין 100 המינים הפולשים המזיקים ביותר בעולם
claims.verified_figure: Listed on IUCN/ISSG '100 of the World's Worst Invasive Alien Species' (entry #68). ISSG says the list is not a severity ranking: species were picked to illustrate invasion issues, one per genus, and 'absence from the list does not imply that a species poses a lesser threat'.
claims.note: The species is on the 100 Worst list, so the '100' figure checks out. The word 'מדורגת' ('ranked') is slightly loose, since ISSG describes the list as an illustrative selection rather than a ranking, but the substance is right.

claims.verified_figure: Ministry of Environmental Protection announcement (Thursday), as reported independently by ynet, INN/Arutz 7, Haipo and others: first identification in Israel, in Neve Sha'anan, Haifa (Givat HaShavshevet area), with reports in Hadar under examination. AntWiki's Israel checklist lists 6 Pheidole species and not P. megacephala.
claims.note: Multiple outlets attribute 'first in Israel' and the Neve Sha'anan location to the ministry, matching N12. No prior Israeli record exists in the AntWiki country checklist. The gov.il release itself could not be located, so the claim rests on consistent secondary reports of the ministry statement.
